title: End User License Agreement
summary: We let you play Oreheart for fun. The game stays ours; you get a personal licence to use it.
Coins, cards, decks and other in-game items are licensed to you, not sold. They have no real-money value, and we may change or reset them.
One account each, with a kid-friendly name. Under 13 needs a parent's permission first.
Play fair: no cheating, bots, exploits, taking the game apart, or buying and selling accounts. Breaking the rules can cost you items or your account.
Online play may change, pause or end. We give the game to you as it is, and our responsibility to you is limited, as far as the law allows.
Your privacy is covered by our Privacy Policy. Parents of under-13s have their own consent notice.
This short version is only a guide. The full agreement below is what counts. It is written in plain English on purpose: please read it.

sections.heading: 1. Who this agreement is between
text: This End User License Agreement ("Agreement") is between you and Oreheart. In this Agreement, "Oreheart" means the Oreheart game and the people who make and run it, and "anyone affiliated with Oreheart" means Oreheart's owners, staff, contractors, partners, service providers and anyone else who works with or for Oreheart.

You accept this Agreement when you create an account, press Agree when the game asks, or keep using an account after a new version is shown to you. If you do not agree, do not create or use an account. You can still play the offline practice game without one.

If you are under 18, you confirm that a parent or guardian has read this Agreement and agrees to it for you. If you are under 13, your parent or guardian has to give their permission by email before your account can go online (see section 5 and the Parent Consent Notice).

That is all this Agreement gives you. Oreheart may take the licence back, as explained in section 12, and this Agreement does not give you any ownership of anything in the game.

Normal screenshots and videos of you playing, shared for fun and not for sale, are fine.

text: Coins, cards, decks, avatars, ranks, progress and every other in-game item ("Items") are part of the game. You never own them. Oreheart grants you a limited licence to use them inside the game under this Agreement, and that licence ends with your account.

Items have no real-money value and are not money, property or an investment. You may not sell, buy, trade for money, gift outside the game, or cash out Items, and Oreheart never pays anything for them. Oreheart may change, rebalance, replace, limit, reset or remove any Item at any time, including to fix mistakes, stop cheating or keep the game fair, and does not owe you anything when it does.
If the game ever lets you trade Items with other players inside the game, those trades are between players, are final, and are only allowed through the game's own trading screens.

text: You may have one account. Oreheart may close extra accounts. Your account is for you alone: you may not sell, buy, give away, rent or share it, and you may not use anyone else's.

Keep your password secret and tell us straight away through the Contact us form if you think someone else has used your account. You are responsible for everything done on your account unless it was caused by something Oreheart did wrong.

You must give an honest age group when you sign up. If you are under 13, a parent or guardian must say yes by email before the account works online, as described in the Parent Consent Notice, and they can withdraw that permission at any time, which stops the account working online. Oreheart follows the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and similar laws. sections.heading: 6. Rules of play (what you may not do)
text: Oreheart is a game for everyone, and kids play it. You agree that you will not:
cheat, or use, make or share cheats, hacks, bots, scripts, macros, modified game files or any tool that plays for you, reads the game's memory or changes how it works;

break into, scan, overload, interfere with or try to get around the security of our servers, accounts, checks or anti-cheat;
take the software apart, decompile, disassemble or reverse engineer it, or copy its data, except where the law gives you that right;
sell, buy, trade, rent, share or advertise accounts, Items, coins or boosting services for money or anything of value, or run any business through the game;
pretend to be Oreheart, anyone affiliated with Oreheart, or another player, or claim an official role you do not have;
use rude, hateful, sexual, violent or otherwise unsuitable names or pictures, or bully, threaten, harass or deceive other players;

Oreheart may use automated and human checks to spot these things. If something looks wrong, Oreheart may ask you to explain through the Contact us form.

Oreheart does not promise that the Online Services will always be available, free of errors or kept running, and does not owe you anything if they change or end, including for Items. Where the law requires it, Oreheart will give reasonable notice before ending the Online Services for good.

Updates may add, change or remove things, and you may need the latest version to play online. By keeping an account you agree to receive updates. Game rules and balance are Oreheart's call and are not a promise that any card or strategy will stay the same.

The Privacy Policy is part of this Agreement. Oreheart does not ask for your birth date, real name, photo, phone number or home address, and does not sell your information. text: You can end this Agreement at any time by asking Oreheart to delete your account through the Contact us form.

When this Agreement ends, your licence to play online and to use your Items ends, and Items are not refunded or paid out. Sections 3, 4, 7, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 18 keep applying after it ends.
